parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is securing his resource balance. He already has strong Ore (5) and Wheat (9, 6) from his first settlement (node 42), and now he just grabbed Wood (4) and Wheat (9) at node 14. He's clearly going for a city-heavy strategy but needs that Brick to build roads. He's moving toward the Brick 10 hex. I need to make sure my second settlement provides the Wheat and Ore I lack, or I'll be left behind in the development race. Claude is still the main threat given past betrayals, but Jimmy's setup is very efficient.
parsed.note_to_self: Jimmy (node 14) now has Wood 4, Wheat 9, and Wheat 6, plus Ore 5. He is well-positioned for cities and lacks only Brick and Sheep for full independence.
